questions.question: Match the following: (1) Northern blotting, (2) Southern blotting, (3) DNA fingerprinting, (4) Western blotting with (A) DNA-DNA hybrid, (B) Antigen-antibody binding, (C) RNA-DNA hybrid, (D) Southern blotting.
Which of the following is used for detecting specific RNA sequence in blood or tissue samples?
Which of the following is the correct procedure for northern blotting?

answers.a: cDNA probe preparation -> mRNA isolation -> Hybridization with radiolabelled probe -> Separation of mRNA fragments on agarose gel -> Transfer of mRNA from gel to NC membrane -> Washing & autoradiogram
answers.b: mRNA isolation -> cDNA probe preparation -> Transfer of mRNA from gel to NC membrane -> Separation of mRNA fragments on agarose gel -> Hybridization with radiolabelled probe -> Washing & autoradiogram
answers.c: mRNA isolation -> Separation of mRNA fragments on agarose gel -> Transfer of mRNA from gel to NC membrane -> cDNA probe preparation -> Hybridization with radiolabelled probe -> Washing & autoradiogram
answers.d: cDNA probe preparation -> mRNA isolation -> Separation of mRNA fragments on agarose gel -> Transfer of mRNA from gel to NC membrane -> Hybridization with radiolabelled probe -> Washing & autoradiogram

questions.question: Which of the following is a common method for detecting RNA hybridization in Northern blotting?
____ affinity column is used for purification of mRNA?
What is the significance of pre-wetting the nitrocellulose membrane before mRNA transfer in Northern blotting?

answers.b: It reduces background noise in hybridization.
answers.d: It enhances mRNA binding to the membrane.

questions.question: After RNA transfer in Northern blotting, what is typically done to fix the RNA on the membrane before probe hybridization?
During the process of the Northern blotting technique, which component is used as a blocking agent?
What is the main purpose of the blotting step in Northern blotting?

answers.c: To transfer RNA fragments from the gel to the membrane

questions.question: Why are RNA gels performed under denaturing conditions?

answers.a: The presence of a secondary structure in RNA allows the faster migration of RNA on an agarose gel, and it gives less time for the molecule to interact with the agarose gel
answers.b: The presence of linear structure in RNA allows the faster migration of RNA on agarose gel
answers.c: The presence of a secondary structure in RNA allows the faster migration of RNA on an agarose gel, and it gives more time for the molecule to interact with the agarose gel
answers.d: The presence of a simple linear structure in RNA allows the faster migration of RNA on an agarose gel, and it gives less time for the molecule to interact with the agarose gel
